cues.en: Mike: This section of the course is all about descriptive statistics, and so I thought I would start this section with the video that not only explains what descriptive statistics are,
cues.zh: 這一節全是敘述統計，所以想先用一部影片，不只解釋敘述統計是什麼，

cues.en: so I'm gonna define descriptive statistics in this video, but I also want to show explicitly what is the difference
cues.zh: 也就是給它定義，還要明確展示，

cues.en: between descriptive statistics and inferential statistics.
cues.zh: 敘述統計與推論統計的差別。

cues.en: It turns out that descriptive statistics and inferential statistics are two totally different things.
cues.zh: 兩者其實是完全不同的東西。

cues.en: They have different analyses, different implications, people use them for different purposes, but they are often confused because they both contain the word statistics.
cues.zh: 分析不同、含意不同、用途不同，但因為都有統計兩個字，經常被混淆。

cues.en: So I get annoyed at this, it's rather unfortunate that we use the same term, statistics, because these are very different things.
cues.zh: 這讓我很煩惱。使用同樣的統計一詞很不幸，因為兩者很不同。

cues.en: Okay, so let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Here, I'm gonna list some features and characteristics of descriptive statistics versus inferential statistics.
cues.zh: 列出敘述統計與推論統計的一些性質、特徵。

cues.en: Let's start with descriptive statistics.
cues.zh: 先從敘述統計開始。

cues.en: So the point of descriptive statistics is to obtain individual numbers that characterize features of a sample dataset or any dataset.
cues.zh: 目的是取得個別數字，描述某個樣本資料集，或任何資料集的特徵。

cues.en: So for example, we can have characteristics of central tendency, characteristics of dispersion, or the overall shape of the distribution.
cues.zh: 例如集中趨勢、離散程度，或整體分布形狀。

cues.en: If these are time series data, we might be interested in the frequency domain spectrum of the signal.
cues.zh: 如果是時間序列資料，可能對訊號的頻域頻譜感興趣。

cues.en: So these are just some examples of descriptive statistics, well, these are the most common descriptive statistics that people use, not the only ones.
cues.zh: 這些是敘述統計的例子，也是最常見的，但不是全部。

cues.en: Now, important to note, when we're talking about descriptive statistics, we do not care about the relationship between our sample data and the population from which those samples were drawn.
cues.zh: 要注意，談敘述統計時，不關心樣本資料，與抽出這些樣本的母體之間有什麼關係。

cues.en: We're not trying to generalize from our sample to other samples or other populations, we're not trying to compare the characteristics of one dataset with the characteristics
cues.zh: 不試圖由樣本推廣到其他樣本或母體，也不試圖比較某資料集與，

cues.en: of a different dataset, that's not the point of descriptive statistics.
cues.zh: 另一資料集的特徵，這不是敘述統計的目的。

cues.en: The point of descriptive statistics is simply to have a small number of numbers, so a few characteristics that describe
cues.zh: 敘述統計只是用少量數字、幾個特徵，描述，

cues.en: the features of a particular set of data.
cues.zh: 某個特定資料集的性質。

cues.en: So that's descriptive statistics.
cues.zh: 這就是敘述統計。

cues.en: Now we get to inferential statistics, and the goal of inferential statistics is to use features of a sample dataset
cues.zh: 接著推論統計，目的是利用樣本資料集的特徵，

cues.en: to make generalizations, to make claims about a population from which that sample was drawn.
cues.zh: 進行推廣，對抽出該樣本的母體提出主張。

cues.en: So the kinds of numbers that are associated with inferential statistics are P-values, and T-values, F-values, chi-square values,
cues.zh: 相關的數量，包括p值、t值、F值、卡方值，

cues.en: confidence intervals, hypothesis testing.
cues.zh: 信賴區間與假設檢定。

cues.en: Obviously, you are going to learn all about these kinds of quantities later on in the course in a few sections from now.
cues.zh: 再過幾節，當然會學到這些量。

cues.en: But I hope you can already start to see that inferential statistics is quite different from descriptive statistics.
cues.zh: 但希望你已開始看出，推論統計與敘述統計很不同。

cues.en: So with inferential statistics, the entire purpose of inferential statistics is to relate our data features to populations or generalize to other groups,
cues.zh: 推論統計的整個目的，是把資料特徵與母體連結，或推廣到其他群體，

cues.en: or compare different values between different datasets or different groups within a dataset.
cues.zh: 或比較不同資料集、同一資料集中不同群體的數值。

cues.en: So this is really a key distinction between inferential statistics and descriptive statistics.
cues.zh: 這真的是推論統計與敘述統計的關鍵區別。

cues.en: With inferential statistics, what we want to do is compare our results across different samples or generalize our results from a sample to a population.
cues.zh: 推論統計要跨不同樣本比較結果，或把樣本結果推廣到母體。

cues.en: With descriptive statistics, we're not trying to do any comparison, we're not trying to do any generalization, all we are trying to do is characterize a particular dataset.
cues.zh: 敘述統計不做比較，也不做推廣，只想刻畫某個特定資料集。

cues.en: So that is the key set of differences between descriptive statistics and inferential statistics.
cues.zh: 這就是兩者的關鍵差異。

cues.en: Again, it's easy to confuse them when you are brand new to statistics because they both have the word statistics, which is really unfortunate, we should have come up with different names,
cues.zh: 剛開始學統計，很容易混淆，因為名稱都有統計。真不幸，應該取不同名稱，

cues.en: but I wasn't involved in the nomenclature for statistics, so I can't take any of the blame here.
cues.zh: 但統計命名時，我沒參與，不能怪我。

cues.en: Anyway, now you know the difference between descriptive statistics and inferential statistics, and with that, we are ready to start discussing some of the key descriptive statistics of the data.
cues.zh: 總之，現在知道敘述與推論統計的差別，就能開始討論資料的一些關鍵敘述統計量。

cues.en: And that's going to lead into the following sections of the course where we will switch to inferential statistics.
cues.zh: 這會帶到後續章節，再切換到推論統計。
